name: @agiterra/wire-codex
description: Wire integration for Codex — the in-process wire MCP (set_plan/heartbeat/register) served stdio for the legacy path and over StreamableHTTP by the injector, plus the per-agent app-server turn-injection engine: inbound Wire events become turn/start, with recycle-before-context-death and a runaway-turn guard. One process per agent, one Wire connection.
author: Tim Garthwaite <https://github.com/mividtim>
